name: GoodHabitz
note: Rating note: Dutch online-training provider, PSV's back-of-shirt sponsor, extended in January 2024 by two seasons. Prosus has held a majority stake since 2021, and Naspers is Prosus's majority owner. Naspers's annual financial statements 2026 list the Public Investment Corporation with 22.53% of Naspers's N ordinary shares and give the Naspers group's effective interest in GoodHabitz as 30.44%: about 6.9% along the chain. The PIC is wholly owned by the South African government (GEPF, https://www.gepf.co.za/who-manages-our-investments/). Whether South Africa has a sourced record of serious abuses hasn't been researched, so the sponsor stays unrated.
